thread.title: Farmers National Bank Increases Holdings in Apple Inc. (AAPL)

author: ABMN Staff
title: Farmers National Bank Increases Holdings in Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Farmers National Bank boosted its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 5.9% in the second the company in its most recent Form 13F and Exchange Commission. The fund owned 12,231 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 684 shares during the period. Apple comprises 1.4% of Farmers National Bank’s portfolio, making the stock its 20th largest holding. Farmers National Bank’s holdings in Apple were worth $2,260,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
A number of other institutional investors and hedge funds have also made changes to their positions in AAPL. Delphi Private Advisors LLC acquired a new position in Apple during the second quarter worth about $120,000. Quattro Financial Advisors LLC acquired a new position in Apple during the first quarter worth about $133,000. CX Institutional acquired a new position in Apple during the second quarter worth about $135,000. Gainplan LLC acquired a new position in Apple during the first quarter worth about $200,000. Finally, Diversified Investment Strategies LLC acquired a new position in Apple during the second quarter worth about $206,000. Institutional investors own 57.10% of the company’s stock.
